subject: English
passage: Hovering flight allows Anna's hummingbird to remain nearly motionless in the air while feeding. ______ this maneuver comes at a substantial energy cost, requiring the bird to sustain roughly 50 wingbeats per second.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. 'On the other hand' logically contrasts a benefit of hovering flight—the ability to remain nearly motionless while feeding—with a drawback of this maneuver—its substantial energy cost.
